configFiles.template:
set sv_licenseKey "${LicenseKey}"

# you probably don't want to change these!
# only change them if you're using a server with multiple network interfaces
endpoint_add_tcp "${IPAddress}:${GamePort}"
endpoint_add_udp "${IPAddress}:${GamePort}"

start mapmanager
start chat
start spawnmanager
start sessionmanager
start fivem
start hardcap
start rconlog
start scoreboard
start playernames

sv_scriptHookAllowed 1

# change this
rcon_password ${RconPassword}

sv_hostname "${Hostname}"

# nested configs!
#exec server_internal.cfg

# loading a server icon (96x96 PNG file)
#load_server_icon myLogo.png

# convars for use from script
set temp_convar "hey world!"

# disable announcing? clear out the master by uncommenting this
#sv_master1 ""

# want to only allow players authenticated with a third-party provider like Steam?
#sv_authMaxVariance 1
#sv_authMinTrust 5

# add system admins
add_ace group.admin command allow # allow all commands
add_ace group.admin command.quit deny # but don't allow quit
add_principal identifier.steam:110000112345678 group.admin # add the admin to the group

# hide player endpoints in external log output
sv_endpointprivacy true

# server slots limit (default to 30)
sv_maxclients ${Slots}

script.name: Download Linux game files
script.description: Downloads the latest FXServer Linux artifact and cfx-server-data into the game files folder.

script.name: Set FiveM executable permissions
script.description: Restores the execute bit on run.sh, FXServer and the musl loader before every start.
script.code:
#!/bin/sh
cd "${ThisService_RootDirectory}" || exit 0

chmod +x run.sh 2>/dev/null
chmod +x alpine/opt/cfx-server/run.sh 2>/dev/null
chmod +x alpine/opt/cfx-server/FXServer 2>/dev/null
chmod +x alpine/opt/cfx-server/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1 2>/dev/null
chmod +x alpine/lib/ld-musl-x86_64.so.1 2>/dev/null

exit 0
